title: Align xtask interactive scaffolding to .cbd templates

plan.notes: Reviewed xtask/src/main.rs and .cbd templates; identified interactive drift.
Drafted contract in .cbd/contracts/0001.contract.json and aligned bundle to task scope.

- Align NT/NE/NR postcondition section names to template headings.
- Trim placeholder lists to tokens present in templates (task: <ID>, <short title> only).
- Confirm epic placeholders cover <EPIC_ID>, <TITLE>, <slug>, <epic_id>.
- Decide on missing-template handling (rely on CLI error propagation).
Updated postcondition section lists to match template headings + unprompted sections, tightened task placeholder wording, and documented template I/O error propagation in assumptions.
No open questions; no clarification rounds required.
Contract status is ready and bundle is build-ready.

build.description: Refactor interactive scaffolding in xtask to render from .cbd templates and replace section bodies based on prompts while preserving headings.
Add tests that confirm template-driven rendering, placeholder replacement, and section insertion for each interactive scaffold command.
Run `xtask cbd verify --id 0001` and update evidence.json with proof locations.
Optional: package a review archive and request a second-pass review.
